summary: Describes the RTP payload format for the Enhanced Variable Rate Codec and the Selectable Mode Vocoder, both speech codecs. Two sub-formats are given, including a bundled and interleaved one that reduces the effect of packet loss. It is a proposed standard.

eli5.summary: Voice is squeezed with special tricks to send it over the net. This memo says how to pack those voice pieces into packets, including a way to shuffle them so a lost packet hurts less.
